subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be closed by accepting a larger fixed Control UI history window, or should closure require offset-based older-message pagination?
rationale: Current source proves the missing older-history path, but the best UX/performance tradeoff is a product decision because the backend already supports pagination and docs describe bounded history for stability.

options.title: Require pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can load older history pages on demand through the existing chat.history offset contract.

options.title: Accept a fixed larger window
options.body: Treat a coordinated fetch/render cap increase as sufficient if maintainers decide the payload cost and remaining cap are acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can load older history pages on demand through the existing chat.history offset contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is primarily WebChat/Control UI product behavior, and steipete has adjacent session/WebChat history in recent commits.
